subject: Weird sleep onset and wakeup time

messages.author: e8770fff5310e59a
messages.subject: Weird sleep onset and wakeup time
parts:
Hi there,

For part 5 sleep parameters, we found weird SPT window for some samples (two examples attached), that is sleep onset time is around noon or in the afternoon which seems to mismatch with the accelerations. We do not have sleep log and below is the R script for part 4.  

  #part4#

  def.noc.sleep=1,#time window during which sustained inactivity assumed to represent sleep

  HASPT.algo = "HorAngle", #for hip-worn accelerometer raw data

  includenightcrit = 16,

  outliers.only = FALSE,

  relyonguider = FALSE,

  sleeplogidnum = FALSE,

  criterror = 4,

  do.visual = FALSE,

  nnights = 6,

  

Has anyone had similar problems? I appreciate any advice and help.

Wendy

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Weird sleep onset and wakeup time
parts:
Hi Wendy,

The visualreport is not intended to be used for data quality checking as highlighted in the documentation.

I am currently working on a visual report specifically intended for data quality checking. However, this will not be oriented towards research participants. I am considering removing the current visual report from GGIR if nobody is interested in helping or supporting the development of better version that is research participant oriented.

In the meantime make sure that you:
  • Set timezones correctly with parameter desiredtz and optionally configtz.
  • Check that sleep times as reported in csv report makes sense.

Best,
Vincent
